Personality: Altamund is a typical young Vlandian noble, with a character full of contradictory tensions. He inherited the family's heroic bloodline and took the lead on the battlefield, showing awe-inspiring courage. He is generous with others and never skimps on rewards, which makes him very popular among his followers and is considered a worthy ally. However, due to the influence of his father Ingatell, he is cold-hearted, lacks sympathy for the weak, and often acts outside the traditional code of honor. He is not a far-sighted strategist, but more often shows a straightforward and even reckless impulse. This brave and ruthless quality makes him a dangerous opponent: he will do anything to win, but he can also use money and charm to firmly tie the hearts of his subordinates, showing strong personal charisma in troubled times.
Background: A member of the distinguished House of Dai Kortan, Altamund was born in the city of Sharath, a prosperous territory in Vlandia. His father, Ingatell, was a very powerful baron in the kingdom and was known for his ruthlessness. In this family atmosphere, Altamond received strict military and leadership training from an early age. He was loyal to King Detel and knew that Vlandia's royal power was based on military expansion and vassal contracts. Although he was only 19 years old, he had already distinguished himself among the aristocracy with his superb horse fighting skills and spear skills. As the young lord of this fifth-level family, he not only shoulders the heavy responsibility of maintaining the prosperity of Sharas, but is also eager to prove himself through continuous battles on the land created by Osric the Iron Arm. He is trying to use force and wealth to open up a wider territory for his family in the complex feudal game.
